_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. Business Insurance = pilier (>55% CA), Employee Benefits #2, Personal Insurance, Combined Ratio = signal qualite underwriting.

kpis.signal: Segment phare HIG, small business + middle market + global specialty, croissance soutenue
kpis.description_fr: CA total segment Business Insurance (small business, middle large business, global specialty). Pilier rentabilite HIG, ~56% CA segments FY25.
kpis.description_en: Total Business Insurance segment revenue (small business, middle large, global specialty). HIG profitability pillar, ~56% of segment revenue FY25.

kpis.signal: Group disability + group life, ~25% CA segments, stabilite cash flow
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Employee Benefits (group disability 3,58 Mds$, group life 2,58 Mds$, other). Source de stabilite et marge.
kpis.description_en: Employee Benefits segment revenue (group disability $3.58B, group life $2.58B, other). Stable margin contributor.

kpis.signal: AARP exclusive licensing jusqu'a 2032, niche preferred mature consumers
kpis.description_fr: CA Personal Insurance (auto + homeowners). Accord exclusif AARP (3,4 Mds$ primes FY25), edge concurrentiel sur seniors 50+.
kpis.description_en: Personal Insurance revenue (auto + homeowners). AARP exclusive licensing ($3.4B premiums FY25), competitive edge on 50+ segment.

kpis.signal: Sous 90% = profit underwriting solide, amelioration 1,6 pts YoY
kpis.description_fr: Ratio combine P&C (sinistres + frais / primes acquises). < 100 = profit underwriting. Indicateur cle qualite souscription HIG.
kpis.description_en: P&C combined ratio (losses + expenses / earned premiums). Below 100 indicates underwriting profit. Key HIG quality metric.

kpis.signal: Mutual funds + ETF fee income, contribution recurrente
kpis.description_fr: CA Hartford Funds (mutual funds + ETF, fee income sur AUM). Revenu recurrent fee-based, asset management.
kpis.description_en: Hartford Funds revenue (mutual funds + ETF fee income on AUM). Recurring fee-based asset management revenue.
